summary: Iteration 5: Validated dead-cookie detection fix in bid-engine.js. node --check clean. All 9 test groups in tests/test-window-scheduler.js pass, including new testDeadCookieDetection (alive-at-start, 3× 403-after-refresh triggers dead flag + future _deadUntil, mid-stream 2xx resets counter). Static grep confirms all 4 required properties: (a) auth._deadCount + auth._deadUntil set in sapRequest, (b) LOUD ERROR log with 🔒, cookie.txt/token.txt paths, DevTools guidance, pm2 restart instruction, (c) fetchLiveOrders early-returns silently when res.data._cookieDead is true (no warn spam), (d) any 2xx/3xx response clears _deadCount (self-heal). Env vars AUTH_DEAD_THRESHOLD default 3 and AUTH_DEAD_COOLDOWN_MS default 30000 honored. While _deadUntil is in future, sapRequest short-circuits with {statusCode:401, data:{_cookieDead:true, remainingMs}} WITHOUT hitting SAP — saves rate-limit budget. No behavioral change to happy path or prior 8 test groups.
critical_code_review_comments: Clean, defensive implementation. Short-circuit before doOnce() correctly saves an HTTP call while dead. Counter reset on 2xx/3xx enables mid-run self-heal when the user updates cookie.txt. Log message is actionable and includes exact file names (via path.basename) + restart command.
test_credentials: N/A — no SAP cookies available; validated via static analysis + unit tests as instructed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/bikas-bidding && node tests/test-window-scheduler.js — expect 9 groups all pass. Dead-cookie logic lives at bid-engine.js:395-443 (sapRequest) and 637-639 (fetchLiveOrders suppression). No live SAP calls possible without cookie.txt.
rca of the issue: SAP returns fresh CSRF token via SessionSet('') even when the underlying browser session/cookie is dead (logged out elsewhere, admin killed). Prior code retried CSRF refresh on every 403 → infinite 403 loop that spammed SAP and log.warn. Fix: track consecutive post-refresh 403 counts on auth._deadCount; after AUTH_DEAD_THRESHOLD (3), set auth._deadUntil = now + 30s and emit ONE loud ERROR-level instruction. During cooldown, sapRequest returns synthetic 401+_cookieDead marker without hitting SAP. fetchLiveOrders checks marker and suppresses the per-poll warn. Any successful response clears the counter (self-heal). Reproduction: mock sapPool to always return 403; observe counter increments to 3, _deadUntil set, subsequent calls short-circuit. Mitigation for user: follow the emitted instructions — paste fresh Cookie header from DevTools into cookie.txt, delete token.txt, pm2 restart.
